integrity: Analytic proof is self-contained; deterministic integral checks and direct deck-image Monte Carlo are supplementary. No independent scientific audit or external certification has occurred.
limitations: Classification holds for rectangular flat length-metric cylinders and Möbius bands with uniform area sampling, not all bands or all compact surfaces. Exact literature priority remains subject to accessible-source limits.
title: Distance statistics detect the half-twist of a flat Möbius band
